visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a blue tiara and a blue-and-white cape sits at a table with plates of spaghetti and potato chips. He holds a chip and speaks to the camera. The background is a digital overlay of a grand marble palace hall with white pillars and a staircase. (2) Close-up shot of a white bowl containing a small carrot and two dark twigs floating in water, representing a melted snowman. (3) The man eats spaghetti vigorously and then screams with wide-open eyes while holding bread in both hands. (4) He eats a chicken drumstick enthusiastically. (5) The scene shifts to an outdoor pavement area where the man stands over a large magic circle drawn in chalk. He performs dramatic hand gestures. (6) Visual effects of blue frost and light emanate from the ground around him. (7) High-quality game animation footage from AFK Journey appears, showing characters in a snowy environment and interface elements. (8) The man appears in front of game-related backgrounds, giving a thumbs up and pointing.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家好我是冰雪公主. (2) [Subtitle]: 我的國度在我的統治之下過得非常的好. (3) [Subtitle]: 看我的身材就知道. (4) [Subtitle]: 人民呢 豐衣足食、安居樂業. (5) [Subtitle]: 對吧雪寶. (6) [Variety]: ...... (7) [Subtitle]: 啊 前幾年 因為變得暖和 他融化了 我非常難過. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以我變得暴飲暴食 絕對不是因為我貪吃哦. (9) [Subtitle]: 我同時也失去了我的魔法. (10) [Variety]: ？？？. (11) [Subtitle]: 報告公主 我們準備好了. (12) [Subtitle]: 終於啊 為了讓你復活 讓你不再融化 我不斷地進食. (13) [Subtitle]: 增強我的魔法力量 好讓全世界都變成我的 冰雪國度. (14) [Logo]: AFK Journey. (15) [Slogan]: 劍與遠征：啟程 新賽季 冬夜殘響. (16) [Subtitle]: 不然你以為 我想變那麼胖嗎？. (17) [Slogan]: 1月17日 冬夜之禮.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator appearing throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A middle-aged man with short hair wearing a black t-shirt, a blue tiara, a blue bow ribbon at the neck, and a blue-and-white cape.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor grand marble palace with pillars (digital overlay), an outdoor pavement area with a temple building in the background, and various AFK Journey game screens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The main speaker begins with a playful, performative tone over light orchestral BGM. A distinct crunch sound is heard as he eats a chip. (2) A moment of silence occurs as the camera focuses on the bowl, with a soft water dripping sound effect. (3) The speaker's intensity increases to shouting and heavy chewing/slurping sounds as he eats pasta. (4) A loud, sustained vocal scream triggers a swell in the epic BGM. (5) A new, deep off-screen male voice reports readiness. (6) The main speaker transitions to a villainous, dramatic tone followed by loud, echoing laughter. (7) High-frequency synth 'whoosh' effects accompany the magic circle activation. (8) Professional narration with balanced, clear delivery takes over, describing the game's new season features over a heroic orchestral theme.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Persona Introduction -> Conflict Setup (Melted Snowman) -> Ritual Action (Overeating for Magic) -> Climax (Magic Reveal) -> CTA Product Integration
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comedic skit serving as a promotion for the mobile game 'AFK Journey'. The creator adopts a humorous 'Ice Queen' persona, using the loss of a snowman and magic power as a funny justification for his eating habits, which eventually leads to a dramatic reveal of the game's new winter season content.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the game title, seasonal update information, and game footage.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy comedic performance with professional level post-production graphics and game asset integration designed for social media engagement.
